[[Kanaxai's Mallet]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from [[Kanaxai's Chest]], which spawns after [[Kanaxai]] is defeated in [[The Deep]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]] 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Stone Crusher (weapon)|Stone Crusher]] [[dye]]d black.
